《BodyRecords》是一款类致命公司的多人恐怖探索游戏，我们将前往一个完全陌生的地方进行探索，这里会有各种各样恐怖的怪物袭击我们，也会有陷阱地形等其他危险着我们的生命，保持理智，观察情况，找寻出路。 恐怖游戏自己一个人玩是恐怖游戏，人越多越欢乐，在类致命公司游戏里，联机并不罕见，因此我们可以叫上朋友一起玩，和朋友一起共同协力解谜，会变得轻松很多，谨慎的躲避危险，才可能于最后成功脱离这里。 在游戏中，我们的视角将会变成体感摄像头，屏幕跟着鼠标的移动带来的摄像头晃动感让人身临其境，真实度大大增加，左下角还有摄像头带的标志，同时右上方还有摄像头已经录制的时间，来提醒我们进入这里多久了。 同时这款游戏内的麦克风与相关类型的游戏一样，玩家发出的声音，会被能听到声音的怪物所感应到并发送攻击，因此在开口说话之前，请多掂量一下自身所处情况，不要贸然开口，导致自己与队友遇害。 在这类游戏中，死亡似乎总是常态，因此总会不小心遇到什么情况死掉，不需要担心，在本作死亡时，我们会进入另一个空间“密室”，在这个密室中也会有别的怪物等着我们，但如果可以成功从这里逃脱，就还有机会回到现实世界。 总的来说，这款游戏其实还不错，毕竟是踩在巨人的肩膀上，玩法有趣，内容偏多，那自然会引来许多喜欢这种类型的人，但很可惜的是，这款游戏没有中文，这让我很难受，毕竟我的英文并不好，所以，我最后只想说一句“We need Chiese！” [quote]关注鉴赏组：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45134494]浮生评测[/url] ←"浮生若梦，一鉴倾心，邀您共赏人间烟火" 加入Steam组：[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/LLFLLFF]浮生评测[/url]←“一起追寻'浮生若梦'般的游戏体验” 开始“浮生若梦”鉴赏组的奇幻之旅！[/quote]

But bugs might block replay fun.[/td] [/tr] [tr] [td]💲Price[/td] [td]8[/td] [td]Fair if you enjoy experimental horror. Worth it for those following indie horror projects.[/td] [/tr] [/table] [i]I played this game with my boyfriend. I was scared at first but intrigued by the gameplay. Despite its flaws, I was genuinely drawn in and wanted more from it. One of those oddball games you want to root for.[/i] [h1][b] 📝Story/Plot without spoilers:[/b][/h1] [table][tr][td] 🔸 In BodyRecords, you are dropped into a large-scale eerie world with minimal direction and one mission: survive, explore, and escape. Through a bodycam perspective you and your team must uncover mysteries, solve tricky puzzles, and avoid death. But even death isn't the end—because it drops you into a creepy, liminal "Backrooms"-like dimension with its own escape path. A strong survival idea that’s more about teamwork and tension than spoon-fed narrative. [/td][/tr][/table] [h1][b]🎮Gameplay:[/b][/h1] [table][tr][td] 🔸 BodyRecords doesn’t hold your hand – and whether that’s a good thing or not will depend entirely on what kind of horror gamer you are. The game throws you into an open, eerie environment with minimal guidance and expects you to figure things out. It’s cooperative at its core, and trust me, you’ll want a friend—because solving puzzles while whispering instructions and hiding from monsters adds a real layer of stress. ------🔹The puzzle design is both creative and infuriating. From solving radio signal sequences, powering up generators, finding secret message to opening locked-down facilities—there’s a lot to figure out. But here’s the catch: the game gives you no hints. Some puzzles feel fresh and genuinely fun once you figure them out, while others will have you aimlessly running around unless you already know what you’re doing. That lack of signposting can kill the pacing. A toggleable hint system could fix a lot.[/td][/tr][/table] [h1][b]📷Graphics:[/b][/h1] [table][tr][td] 🔸 Gritty, VHS-styled visuals with low-light and liminal environments match the tone perfectly. While nothing super high-fidelity, the intentional design creates a believable horror setting. The Backrooms area, though visually cool, suffers from a goofy monster animation that breaks immersion a bit. [/td][/tr][/table] [h1][b]📝Main Pros and Cons:[/b][/h1] [b] 🟩Pros-[/b] + Tense, immersive atmosphere. + I support this ambition. + Smart environmental puzzles (when they work). + Fun in co-op. + Backrooms. [b] 🔴Cons-[/b] - Navigation bugs and physics issues. - ATV and terrain traversal need major work. - Some enemy animations feel silly and unpolished. - Minimal in-game guidance can be frustrating. [h1][b]😇Verdict:[/b][/h1] [table][tr][td] 🔸 BodyRecords feels like a prototype of something special. It’s clunky, yes. But it’s also bold, fresh, and different. I was annoyed by certain bugs and design oversights, but I was equally fascinated by its atmosphere and potential. If you’re into co-op horror with strange charm and evolving design, this is one to watch—and one to try now if you're feeling adventurous. Not polished, but promising. [/td][/tr][/table] Rating: 7/10 Wouldn’t survive 5 minutes if monsters could smell fear. For full review head over to our [url=https://www.united-critics.com/post/body-records]website[/url]
